stories.headline: Dutch court asked to halt Meta smart glasses sales over privacy
stories.subtitle: Dutch consumer groups asked an Amsterdam court Nov 26 to halt sales of Meta's AI glasses, saying wearers can film people without their knowledge. Meta points to the recording light; a ruling is expected in December and sales continue for now.

stories.headline: Germany's consumer group sues Meta and Luxottica over smart glasses privacy
stories.subtitle: Germany's consumer federation sued Meta and Luxottica, saying buyers weren't told data-protection law restricts filming in public, and that Meta implies every advertised feature can be used without limits. No ban is in force; sales continue.

stories.headline: Meta's Black Friday sale ends Monday: Gen 2 $284, Meta Glasses $254
stories.subtitle: The sale ends 11:59 PM PT Monday Nov 30: Gen 2 is $284 (25% off $379) and Oakley HSTN $299, while Vanguard and select Meta Glasses are 15% off — the $299 Meta Glasses models are $254. Display and Gen 3 are excluded.

stories.headline: Rent and buy 3D movies on Meta Quest, including Billie Eilish's concert film
stories.subtitle: Quest owners in the US can now rent and buy 3D movies in the TV app on Quest 3 and 3S, including Billie Eilish's HIT ME HARD AND SOFT concert film. With Disney+ 3D streaming already live, 3D on Quest is becoming a real selling point.

stories.headline: Quest 3S + Xbox bundle: meta.com lists $339.98 — check the cart before quoting
stories.subtitle: Meta's blog still lists the Quest 3S 128GB + Xbox Nano controller bundle at $399.98, but meta.com shows $339.98. The in-store price is unverified, so confirm in the cart before quoting either figure to a customer.
